sourceReview.registration: NumberRegistrationsController.authorize accepts nonce/code only. NumberRegistrationService.options/confirm use the encrypted candidate from that code exchange, validate provider membership, then promote the credential and durable provider identity. sourceReview.grantBoundary: MetaHttpClient.recursos/assertCurrentGrant require explicit granular management/messaging target intersection. The all-objects USER token inspected in Explorer is not a drop-in channel credential and must not be substituted through env/SQL or accepted by loosening the existing OAuth boundary implicitly.
sourceReview.subscription: After local confirmation, advance resolves the channel credential and subscribes its selected Messaging account. A manual Graph subscription is not local identity/credential promotion.
sourceReview.ingress: MetaWebhookController looks up metadata.phone_number_id and its current channel. If no current mapping exists, it returns without registering an inbox message and the endpoint can still return200. Verified identity is also required. No pre-registration replay or import is established by this contract; a new message will be needed after completing the binding.
